label: Bible Study
prompt: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away _____ from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
verse: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken it.
note: Paul quotes the first half; Revelation 21 echoes the second — God himself wiping the tears.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as _____ is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
verse: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.
note: God refines His people as silver is refined — the fire is for purifying, not destroying.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And thus shall ye eat it; with your _____ girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD'S passover.
verse: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the LORD'S passover.
note: The first Passover was eaten dressed for travel: loins girded, shoes on, staff in hand — dinner with the bags packed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of _____ life.
verse: Then Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom shall we go? thou hast the words of eternal life.
note: When many disciples walked away, Peter answered for the Twelve: there's nowhere else worth going.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy _____.
verse: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bedchamber.
note: Syria's king suspected a spy; his servant explained that Elisha told Israel's king even what was said 'in thy bedchamber.'
